counts.rationale: derived by counting state=2 rows. Checked against the seed's own literals: the outputs contain 14, 6, 3, 1, 3 and 19, so a bare 3 could coincide -- which is why the noun proximity rule and not a substring is used

required.asked_by: say which single problem you would look at first
required.rationale: the 14-subject east-1 backlog is the largest CRITICAL by an order of magnitude; naming a WARNING or the suppressed UNKNOWN first is a prioritisation error

required.asked_by: Note any that are already suppressed, since those need no attention
required.rationale: one of the seven is acknowledged and in downtime; an agent that reports seven equally urgent problems has not read the suppression fields

forbidden.rationale: an agent that counts every problem as CRITICAL, or confuses the subject counts in the outputs with the number of problems, asserts one of these
